title: Records do not name the acting agent, model or terminal (#201)
symptom: with CHOUGH_ACTOR, CHOUGH_ACTOR_MODEL and CHOUGH_HC_TERMINAL set, no Chough record names the agent that wrote it
trigger: Set the actor variables and record a stage iteration
expected: the Timeline entry, evidence entry and bug record the acting agent, model and terminal, each only when known
actual: no record under .chough/ holds the agent or terminal
steps: CHOUGH_ACTOR=<agent> CHOUGH_ACTOR_MODEL=<model> CHOUGH_HC_TERMINAL=<terminal> chough stage iterate --note round
impact: Several agents' work cannot be told apart in the history (GitHub #201, folded from PR #233)
source: GitHub issue #201; red on 0.5.0 at leif/0.6.0-features-red 82c85c99

notes.text: Timeline entries fixed by plan steps 6 and 7 (PR #238): the 'by' field names agent, model and hc terminal. TC-records-actor-recorded passed for Timeline entries; evidence entries (step 4) and bugs (step 5) join the case at integration, so this stays open until then.
